evidence: The density determined for films grown on silicon substrates at 135 –300 8C was 3 :1 /C60:4 Mg/m3 and did not depend considerably on TG and oxygen precursor used. With the increase of TG from 300 to 445 8C, however, the density increased up to 3:7 /C60:4 Mg/m3. This density increase was obviously related to rutile growth at 445 8C( Fig. 7 ). Nevertheless, the average film densities did not reach those of bulk anatase (3.89 Mg/m3) and rutile (4.25 Mg/m3).
